_doc: Template for a person's skill catalog. Idun copies it to the private cabinet as skills.json during installation and fills in <...>. The sources run in order, and a later source wins on a name clash, so the personal one comes last. This template is for whoever spreads WDS from the WDS clone. Someone who works in an organization's WDS repo needs no WDS clone (Mårten, 2026-11-04): remove the vendor-agents sources and let the WDS commands point to agents/wds in the organization's repo, or use the organization's own template (for example agents/<org>/data/katalog.json).
dev_root: <fallback: the dev folder on the first computer, e.g. C:/dev. Each computer sets its own in dev_root: in ~/.wds/me.md, and the paths below are written as <dev_root>/…>

sources.name: whiteport-design-studio
sources.why: Copies agents/wds/ and the adapters into every WDS repo on the computer, and governance/wds/ where governance is set up. A WDS repo has one of the markers or agents/wds/.wds-sync. Without .wds-sync the repo must be owned by someone in owners and have a commit within active_days days.

sources.name: taste (via whiteport-design-studio)
sources.why: Taste, an external design source (Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT) that has been reviewed and lives in WDS. Copied to the same repos as agents/wds, with adapters in .claude/skills and .agents/skills.

sources.name: whiteport-design-studio (global)
sources.why: The WDS agents and the WDS commands on the whole computer, also in repos that are not WDS repos.

sources.name: <the personal repo>
sources.why: The person's own skills and agents. Last, so the personal one wins. Remove the entry if the person has no personal repo.

project_discovery._doc: Project repos with their own .claude/ are kept up to date (git pull). Their skills apply only in that repo.
